top_choice_rationale: P002 most convincingly combines a defined, mature physiological discovery with exceptional and extensive therapeutic consequences in diabetes and obesity. Its attribution is defensible when the recognition is confined to GLP-1 physiology and biological action that enabled treatment, rather than the wider medicinal-chemistry, industrial, clinical, and delivery chain.
